name: scanservjs
description: scanservjs is a web UI frontend for your scanner (SANE-based). Most network scanners (eSCL/AirPrint) are detected automatically. Important: Read the README to set up your scanner.

paths.name: Scan Output
paths.description: Path for the file output from performed scans

paths.name: dbus
paths.description: dbus (needed for automatic detection of network scanners through bonjour)

variables.name: OCR Language
variables.description: Determines the language that is to be used for OCR (optical character recognition). The value has to conform with tesseracts naming scheme.

variables.name: Ignore Scanimage List
variables.description: Forces the application to ignore the result of the automatic device detection (scanimage -L) and instead only uses the entries present in the configuration file and docker environment variables.

variables.name: Devices
variables.description: Optional: Force a specific scanner if auto-detection fails. To find the correct value, open a shell in the running container and run 'scanimage -L' – copy the string between the backticks, e.g. 'airscan:e0:MyScanner'. Leave empty for automatic detection.
